notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
**Update Notes**

- **New**: Added a chart in the accounting UI for better financial tracking.  
- Toilet prices have been fixed at 10 to prevent mass bot deaths due to lack of basic needs affordability.  
- "Licenses to Live" limits and prices have been reworked to better accommodate a wider range of wealth.  
- Robbers wearing hoods can no longer enter the police station.  
- Robbers' hoods are now automatically removed at the end of the police research cooldown.  
- Fixed a bug where the opponent's name displayed incorrectly during interruptions.  
- Softened several sound effects and added protection against overlapping sounds.  
- Fixed a bug where police research wasn’t properly cleared after sleep.  
- Updated the Steam page images and description, as some visitors mistakenly thought it was a kids' game.  
- Fixed an issue where home toilets appeared as businesses in the trade center.  
- Corrected place names showing incorrectly during character selection.  
- Fixed a bug where hotel rooms occupied by Ray Plicant behaved inappropriately.
- Various additions into the Blektropedia 
- Typos / Translation

Those changes are server-side so you don't need to update the client.

notes.title: The Landing Update ! V1.1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068962/400507d1da3c81b87b3f8402ab865ba20f14734f.jpg

Version 1.1 Update!

The Blêktropedia

As highlighted in a positive Steam review, Blêktre 2081  is unlike any game you've played, making onboarding a challenge.  

But worry no more—the Blêktropedia   is here! This fully illustrated, lore-packed encyclopedia covers the mechanics and everything you need to master your world… and eat your neighbor!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068962/6403492c8f1feceafaf7eb7789dff0b15cfd8630.png

You can also freely access the Blektropedia from the website and will be updated according to players feedback.

New Skin

This update also introduces a new unlockable character: the Doomer! They've returned from the Moon and know the terrible truth about the world. Their dedicated non-human version is also included.  

New Game+

After completing the main story and certifying your score, you can earn and accumulate Moons. Each one can be selected to increase the difficulty when you reroll in New Game+ and further multiply your score!

Various adjustements and bug fixes

- Music volume and SFX sliders 
- A clear visual alert appears when your health drops below 40%  
- Fixed some NPC hats  
- Improved real-time updates for skill effectiveness in combat  
- Carafurs are found all over the world
- The Steam demo no longer requires an account 
- And more ...

Community

Blêktre  is still evolving, and we're always open to your feedback—whether through the in-game form or on Discord.  

More updates and content are on the way!

Love you all!

notes.title: Little Dance Update
notes.notes:
Feature

- People now come to dance when you DJ at the Garden Party.

Tweaks

- Toilet prices have been capped to prevent a sanitation crisis for those who can't afford them.
- A business's capital fully resets if the owner disappears, making buyouts easier.
- The Capo's sausage production objective now decreases faster for a smoother experience.
- Room Safes are now shared among housemates
- Language Selection for mobile
- Various optimizations.
- The demo is now available for Linux.

notes.title: Safety First update
notes.notes:
Released a small update to provide players with more safety information about the dangers of society!  

- An alert now appears if you're vulnerable to police checks (illegal items, criminal status).  
- New perk: Monopolist Scum, when you own several businesses.
- A warning is displayed before taking antidepressants, preventing accidental lifelong addiction.  
- You can no longer slip drugs into NPC pockets—gifts are now limited to gang members.  
- Fanta-Nihil overdose no longer results in death.  
- Corruption: Cops are now immune to police controls.  
- Fixed an animation bug during *The Moon and the Restless* show.  
- Added a safe in your bedroom to store coins securely (limited to your Permit’s maximum).

notes.title: Update Notes for 19/02/2025
notes.notes:
The Prestige New Game+ is now live! You can finally reach the Moon for real—but I won’t spoil anything more.

We also started a series of tweaks to help rebalance the game for small entrepreneurs against big business owners, even in such a capitalist world. 

This is however a work in progress and you can join the discussion on Discord

notes.title: Release of the game !
notes.notes:
After two years of development, Blêktre 2081 is finally fully available on Steam!  

This is my first officially released game, so it's a special moment.  

A huge thank you to all the players who support, test, and buy the game! Have fun!  

Just because the game is out doesn't mean my work is done—I still have features, optimizations, balancing, and events to bring you!  

Feel free to leave a review if you enjoy the game; it can help a lot!  

Love you all!  

Charles
